name: Hero 3 (huntress)
description: a lean, athletic adult woman about 30, a huntress and ranger, with a woman's figure: a long chestnut-brown braid hanging down her back from the nape, a calm weathered face; a deep moss-green hooded half-cloak (a short shoulder cape) reaching the waist at the sides and in a point to the hips at the back, the hood DOWN, fastened at the throat with a bronze leaf clasp; a fitted brown leather jerkin to the hips with a few bold stitched seams, over a cream linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow; long brown leather fingerless bracers; a wide tan belt with a square buckle, a leather pouch at her right hip and a sheathed knife at her left hip; slim moss-green trousers; knee-high brown leather boots with turned-down cuffs. Both hands EMPTY: NO bow, NO quiver, NO arrows, NO weapon held or carried.
body: standard walk guide (adult 1.82 m, EU 43), not a custom female body yet
